resources.name: NaCl shell-model parameters from Raunio & Rolandson (1970)

access.notes: Contains force constants, shell charges, masses, and the short-range parameters A=9.77 and B for NaCl needed to construct the dynamical matrix and evaluate Green functions.

resources.name: Observed local-mode frequency for NaCl:H⁻ (563 cm⁻¹) from Schaefer (1960)

access.notes: Provides the experimental single-ion infrared frequency used to evaluate the Green functions at the target ω and to fit ΔA.
